error-wrapping.latch: a tool call that can fail transiently; a 5xx from the HTTP tool; a wrapper around a flaky call
not_this: a non-transient failure such as a 404, which a retry cannot repair
error-wrapping.stakes: a task that fails on a transient fault scores zero while one retry would pass

http-tool.latch: a tool call that can fail transiently; a 5xx from the HTTP tool; a wrapper around a flaky call
not_this: a non-transient failure such as a 404, which a retry cannot repair
http-tool.stakes: a task that fails on a transient fault scores zero while one retry would pass

shell-tool.latch: a shell tool under a call budget; several files or inputs to inspect
not_this: calls whose inputs depend on a previous call's output
shell-tool.stakes: a budget exceeded fails the task outright

tool-budget.latch: a shell tool under a call budget; several files or inputs to inspect
not_this: calls whose inputs depend on a previous call's output
tool-budget.stakes: a budget exceeded fails the task outright

not_this: a non-transient failure such as a 404, which a retry cannot repair
tool-call-retry.stakes: a task that fails on a transient fault scores zero while one retry would pass
